title: Hai faza o mein imam e asr ki zaqmi sada
body:
hai faza o mein imam e asr ki zaqmi sada, sabera masooma zehra syeda ya tahera.
fatima zehra fatima zehra .
1.meri dadi tujpa sub ho shaam thi kaisi jafa
tera girya teri bechaini wo baad e mustafa
woh masayab ka ta sa sul aur woh tera housla.
<<DIVIDER>>
2.kaise kaise dard ke manzar nigaho mein rahe
kaun jane tune kitne karb ek dil par sahe
tu ne qurban deen par apna bhara ghar kar diya.
<<DIVIDER>>
3.sirf aathara baras ke sin mein aye bintay rasool
doh qadam chalna bhi tujko hogaya mushkil batool
hogaya pehlu shikasta haat mein aaya aasa.
<<DIVIDER>>
4.chadar e tatheer ki markaz woh bintay mustafa
jisko khaliq ke nabi ne baz a tum minni kaha
zulm ne uska kalega tukde tukde kar diya.
<<DIVIDER>>
5.ek bete ka kaleja zehr se tukdeh hua
dasht mein pamal ek bete ka lasha ho gaya
betiya dono hui balway mein haiii berida.
<<DIVIDER>>
6. ye sitam sareh agar roshan dino par toot tay
woh nazar aatay sabhi tareekh mein dubey hue
aaj bhi rota hu mein sunkar woh tera marsiya.
<<DIVIDER>>
7.ho gai duniya se ruksath jis ghadi bintay nabi
sar se aam mama utara aur bohut roe ali
aur yahi thay bain lab par ab mein tanha hogaya.
<<DIVIDER>>
8.de rahe thay gusl moula fatima ko jis ghadi
jane kya guzri dil e muztar pe kyu tadpe ali
sabir o shahkir ali ne kis liye sehaa kiya.
<<DIVIDER>>
9.baad marne ke bhi bibi kya sitam tuj par hue
qabr mein bhi shah zadi reh na pai chain se
zalima ne dha diya rouza tera ya fatima.
<<DIVIDER>>
10.dukthar e bintay nabi hoti rahi paiham shaheed
dein imam e waqt ko ab milke ham pursa rasheed
dein imam e waqt ko pursa tadap kar dein sada.
